versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text: The established flap extended speed V_{FE} must be established so that it does not exceed the design flap speed V_{F} chosen under CS 25.335 (e) and 25.345, for the corresponding wing-flap positions and engine powers.
